This note means **design** paradigms: how to decompose a system. The other sense of the word,
**language** paradigms (imperative, object oriented, functional, declarative), belongs to
[[PROGRAMMING PARADIGMS]]. Different axes: you can write an
[[Object Oriented Approach|object oriented]] design in C, and structured code in [[Java]].
